a scalar total acceptance effect makes context-dependent detector postselection an event-ready Bell test

falsifier: Reject the obstruction if the stated sector effects fail to be marginals of the constructed positive normalized parent, or if any complete deterministic response yields absolute CHSH above 2; preserve the ideal-projector Bell control.
boundary: No hardware run, new probability law, or Marici-versus-QM discrimination. This excludes the specified azimuth-rebinning readout, not a different setting-dependent physical interaction. Existing ideal polarization instruments and scattering-amplitude theorems remain intact.
